entities.name: University of Provence - Aix-Marseille I

entities.summary: Former french university founded in 1971, merged (and hence abolished) in 2012 with university aix marseille ii and aix marseille iii to form the new aix-marseille university Headquartered in Marseille. Founded 1971. Dissolved 2012.
